[[Mo'grosh Stronghold]] is a set of [[ogre]]-infested caves located in northeastern [[Loch Modan]]. The [[ogre]]s number several elite shamans, enforcers, and brutes, ranging from level 18-20. Adventurers come here seeking to eradicate these dangerous enemies of the kingdom, and the most ambitious even attempt to claim the head of the ogres' leader, [[Chok'sul]].
